findings: Allele frequency is proportion of gene copies, not organism phenotype counts. Mutation and migration have distinct origins of change.
Drift arises from finite sampling; selection concerns systematic reproductive differences. Neutral does not imply constant frequency.
Bottleneck is size history, fixation an endpoint without a unique causal signature. Unused census, effective, fitness, recessive and species checked globally.
